body: Pre-review oracle, not yet a candidate finding: leakage.scala arm currently averages each run by dropping absent UnitObservation values. With MetricObservation, a mechanical collect of Observed would still survivor-renormalize an eligible Missing inside LeakageControl, potentially publishing a leakage gain from selected survivors. Please either propagate eligible Missing so that arm/gain is unobserved, with a regression, or explicitly establish that LeakageControl is a different estimand allowed to condition on observed units. I will check this seam in the independent review.
